expected_readback: Remaining on the runway, Lufthansa 495, we are able to vacate via Bravo 9, no fire no apparent damage, but request inspection of left main gear, possible tyre failure.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.15.2, Doc 9432 Emergency Phraseology
hint_tr: Rejected takeoff sonrası tower'a durumu bildirirken: pozisyon (runway'de kalıyor), vacate kabiliyeti, acil durum (fire/damage) ve inspection ihtiyacını net belirt. Callsign her zaman readback'te yer almalı.
hint_en: After rejected takeoff, confirm your position on runway, vacate capability, emergency status (fire/damage), and any inspection request. Always include your callsign in the readback.

atc_utterance: Turkish Airlines 1754, runway 35 in sight, cleared visual approach runway 35, wind 360 degrees 8 knots.
expected_readback: Cleared visual approach runway 35, Turkish Airlines 1754.
hint_tr: Visual approach clearance için callsign, 'cleared visual approach' ve runway numarası readback edilmeli.
hint_en: Readback must include callsign, clearance type (cleared visual approach), and runway number.

atc_utterance: Olympic 521, hold at ABLON as published, expect further clearance time 1425, delay is due traffic.
expected_readback: Hold at ABLON as published, expect further clearance 1425, Olympic 521.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.8.6.5, Annex 10 Vol II
hint_tr: Holding talimatında fix adı, pattern tipi (as published), EFC time ve callsign readback edilmelidir. Delay nedeni readback gerekmez.
hint_en: Readback must include the holding fix, pattern type (as published), EFC time, and callsign. The reason for delay is not required in the readback.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, flight deck. Confirm cabin secure for departure.
expected_readback: Flight deck, cabin secure for departure, all doors armed and cross-checked, seat belt signs observed.
hint_tr: Cabin secure raporunda 'doors armed and cross-checked' ve 'seat belt signs' mutlaka belirtilmeli.
hint_en: Always confirm 'doors armed and cross-checked' and 'seat belt signs' status in cabin secure report.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, doors to arrival and cross-check. Confirm when complete.
expected_readback: Doors to arrival and cross-check, will confirm when complete.
hint_tr: Flight deck'ten gelen 'doors to arrival' komutunu echo edin ve cross-check yapacağınızı onaylayın.
hint_en: Acknowledge the doors-to-arrival instruction and confirm you will perform the cross-check procedure.

atc_utterance: Purser, flight deck. Confirm cabin status for departure. Need passenger count, doors secured, and overhead bins checked.
expected_readback: Flight deck, purser. Boarding complete, one hundred sixty-two passengers on board, all doors armed and cross-checked, overhead bins secure, cabin ready for departure.
icao_ref: Doc 9432 Cabin Crew Safety Training Manual
hint_tr: Purser departure report'ta mutlaka passenger count, door status (armed/cross-checked), overhead bin durumu ve 'cabin ready' ifadesi bulunmalı.
hint_en: Purser departure report must include passenger count, door armed status with cross-check confirmation, overhead bin security, and explicit cabin ready statement.

atc_utterance: Purser, Captain here. Go ahead with your report.
expected_readback: Captain, we have a medical emergency in cabin. Male passenger, approximately 55 years old, seat 14C, complaining of severe chest pain and shortness of breath. He is conscious but in distress. We have administered oxygen and a doctor on board is assisting. Request priority landing and medical assistance on arrival.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9481 (Emergency Response Guidance for Aircraft Incidents), Annex 6 Part I
hint_tr: Medical emergency bildiriminde mutlaka passenger konumu (seat number), semptomlar (chest pain, shortness of breath), yapılan müdahale (oxygen) ve talep (priority landing, medical assistance) belirtilmelidir.
hint_en: Medical emergency reports must include passenger location (seat number), symptoms observed, actions taken (oxygen administration), and specific requests (priority landing, ground medical assistance).

atc_utterance: Purser, Captain here. We've received your report about the unruly passenger in row 23. Is the situation under control now, or do we need to consider diverting to the nearest suitable airport? Please confirm passenger is restrained and no injuries to crew or other passengers.
expected_readback: Captain, Purser. Situation is now under control. Passenger in row 23 is restrained and calm. No injuries to crew or passengers. No diversion required at this time.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 10002 (PANS-ATM safety provisions), Annex 6 Part I crew procedures
hint_tr: Captain'a durum raporu verirken: 'under control', 'restrained', 'no injuries' ve 'diversion' durumu mutlaka belirtilmeli. Purser kimliğini başta söyle.
hint_en: When reporting status to Captain, you must confirm: situation control status, passenger restraint, injury status, and whether diversion is needed. Identify yourself as Purser first.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, we have a passenger at gate requesting seat change from 24B to an aisle seat in rows 20 to 30. Can you check availability?
expected_readback: Copy, checking aisle seat availability rows 20 to 30 for passenger moving from 24B.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 Cabin Crew Safety Training Manual
hint_tr: Seat assignment değişikliğinde hangi koltuk tipi (aisle/window) ve hangi row aralığı belirtilmiş? Eski seat numarasını da readback'e ekle.
hint_en: Confirm the seat type requested (aisle), the row range given, and acknowledge the original seat number in your readback.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, boarding is complete. Confirm you are ready for welcome announcement in economy. Doors are still open.
expected_readback: Boarding complete, ready for welcome announcement in economy, doors open, cabin crew.
hint_tr: Purser'ın talimatını tekrar edin: boarding durumu, announcement hazırlığı ve doors durumunu söyleyin.
hint_en: Repeat back: boarding status, announcement readiness, and door status to confirm understanding.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, this is purser. We have clearance for pushback in two minutes. Confirm all passengers in economy cabin are seated with seatbelts fastened and tray tables stowed.
expected_readback: Purser, economy cabin confirmed. All passengers seated, seatbelts fastened, tray tables stowed. Ready for pushback.
hint_tr: Purser'a economy cabin durumunu rapor ederken 'seatbelts fastened' ve 'tray tables stowed' ifadelerini mutlaka tekrarla.
hint_en: Confirm back to purser that seatbelts are fastened and tray tables are stowed in your cabin section before pushback.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, from the flight deck: we're approaching some moderate turbulence in approximately fifteen minutes. Please complete meal service in economy and secure the carts before we reach that area.
expected_readback: Roger, complete meal service in economy and secure carts within fifteen minutes before turbulence, cabin crew.
icao_ref: ICAO Annex 6 Part I Ch.12 (Cabin Crew Duties)
hint_tr: Purser'dan gelen talimatı tekrarlarken 'complete meal service', 'secure carts' ve zaman dilimini ('fifteen minutes') belirtmelisiniz.
hint_en: Acknowledge the instruction by repeating the key actions: complete meal service, secure carts, and the time frame before turbulence.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, flight deck. Severe turbulence ahead, unable to avoid. Secure cabin immediately and prepare passengers for brace position on my command. Estimate thirty seconds.
expected_readback: Flight deck, cabin. Securing cabin now, preparing passengers for brace position on your command, thirty seconds. Cabin crew.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9481 Emergency Response Guidance for Aircraft Operators
hint_tr: Flight deck'in talimatını readback ederken 'securing cabin', 'brace position on command' ve zaman bilgisini tekrarla. Callsign olarak 'cabin crew' veya pozisyonunu kullan.
hint_en: Acknowledge the command by confirming cabin securing action, brace position readiness with 'on your command', and the time estimate. Close with your position identifier.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, we have six premium passengers requiring pre-boarding assistance today. Four wheelchair passengers gate-to-seat, one passenger with visual impairment, and one unaccompanied minor in seat 3A. Boarding commences in twenty minutes, pre-board starts in ten.
expected_readback: Copy, six premium pre-board passengers. Four wheelchair gate-to-seat, one visual impairment, one unaccompanied minor seat 3A. Pre-board in ten minutes, general boarding in twenty.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9859 Safety Management Manual, Annex 6 Cabin Crew Procedures
hint_tr: Pre-board briefing'de yolcu sayısını, özel ihtiyaçları (wheelchair, visual impairment, unaccompanied minor) ve zamanlamayı (pre-board 10 dakika, boarding 20 dakika) tekrarlamalısınız.
hint_en: In pre-board briefing readback, confirm total number of special needs passengers, specify each category (wheelchair, visual impairment, UM with seat), and acknowledge both pre-board and general boarding timeframes.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, flight deck. We're approximately forty-five minutes from top of descent. Can you confirm business class meal service will be completed and secured before initial descent?
expected_readback: Flight deck, cabin crew. Confirm business class meal service will be completed and secured before initial descent in four-five minutes.
hint_tr: Flight deck'in sorusunu onaylarken 'business class meal service' tamamlanacağını ve 'secured' edileceğini belirtin. Zaman referansını ('four-five minutes') tekrarlayın.
hint_en: Acknowledge the flight deck by confirming the business class meal service will be completed and secured before descent. Include the time reference in your readback.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew business class, we have a passenger in seat 3A requesting a gluten-free meal option. Current inventory shows two gluten-free meals available in forward galley, but one is already allocated for seat 5C who pre-ordered. Please verify if the passenger has a documented allergy or if alternative options would be acceptable.
expected_readback: Understood, passenger seat 3A requesting gluten-free meal, one gluten-free available in forward galley after 5C allocation, will verify allergy status and offer alternatives if needed.
hint_tr: Special meal request'te önce seat numarasını, mevcut meal inventory'yi ve yapılacak action'ı (verify, offer) readback et.
hint_en: For special meal requests, confirm the seat number, available inventory status, and the action you will take to resolve the situation.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, flight deck. We are commencing descent into Istanbul, expect landing in two zero minutes. Secure the cabin for arrival, business class galley, stow all service items and ensure seats upright.
expected_readback: Flight deck, cabin. Commencing descent Istanbul, landing in two zero minutes, securing cabin for arrival, business galley stowing service items, seats upright.
hint_tr: Descent bilgisini, landing zamanını ve cabin preparation talimatlarını sırayla tekrarla. Business class galley sorumluluğunu vurgula.
hint_en: Readback the descent information, landing time, and all cabin preparation instructions in sequence. Acknowledge your business class galley responsibility.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew business, this is purser. We have a complete oven failure in the forward galley with smoke smell. Shutdown galley power circuit breaker immediately, secure all meal service equipment, and report status when ready for passenger announcement.
expected_readback: Purser, cabin crew business. Shutting down forward galley circuit breaker, securing meal service equipment, will report status for passenger announcement.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9481 Emergency Response Guidance for Aircraft Incidents
hint_tr: Galley circuit breaker kapatma talimatını onaylayın ve passenger announcement öncesi durum bildireceğinizi ekleyin.
hint_en: Acknowledge the galley circuit breaker shutdown instruction and confirm you will report status before the passenger announcement.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, boarding will commence in five minutes. First class and premium passengers will board first through door one left. Please ensure your cabin is ready for boarding and confirm when you're ready to receive passengers.
expected_readback: Boarding commencing in five minutes, first class and premium through door one left first, will confirm when ready to receive passengers.
icao_ref: Doc 9432 Cabin Crew Safety Training Manual
hint_tr: Boarding zamanını, hangi yolcu kategorisinin hangi door'dan bineceğini ve hazır olduğunuzda confirm edeceğinizi readback edin.
hint_en: Read back the boarding time, which passenger category boards through which door, and confirm you will report readiness.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, this is purser. We're approximately two hours from top of descent. Please commence first class bedding setup for passengers in seats 1A through 4K. Ensure all lie-flat seats are configured to bed mode with mattress pads, duvets, and full pillow sets. Priority service for passengers who've already requested turndown.
expected_readback: Purser, cabin crew. Commencing first class bedding setup, seats 1A through 4K, lie-flat to bed mode with mattress pads, duvets, and full pillow sets. Priority for passengers who requested turndown. Two hours from top of descent.
key_phrases: seats one alpha through four kilo
mattress pads, duvets, and full pillow sets
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 (Manual of Radiotelephony) - crew coordination procedures
hint_tr: Purser talimatını readback ederken koltuk numaralarını (1A through 4K), bed mode konfigürasyonunu ve öncelikli yolcu taleplerini (turndown requests) tekrar edin. İki saatlik süre bilgisini de teyit edin.
hint_en: Read back the seat range (1A through 4K), bed mode configuration details, mattress pads and duvets, and acknowledge priority for passengers who requested turndown service. Confirm the two-hour time frame before top of descent.

atc_utterance: Cabin, Flight Deck. We're declaring a medical emergency. Passenger in 2A reporting severe chest pain and shortness of breath. Diverting to nearest suitable airport, estimate landing in two-five minutes. Prepare cabin for priority landing, secure premium cabin immediately, and have medical equipment ready at door one left.
expected_readback: Flight Deck, Cabin. Copy medical emergency, passenger two alpha severe chest pain and shortness of breath. Diverting, landing two-five minutes. Preparing cabin for priority landing, securing premium cabin, medical equipment ready door one left.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 Cabin Crew Safety Training Manual
hint_tr: Medical emergency durumunda seat numarası, semptomlar ve tahmini landing time'ı tekrarlamalısınız. Door assignment net olmalı.
hint_en: In medical emergencies, confirm seat number, symptoms, estimated landing time, and specific door assignment for priority handling.

atc_utterance: Cabin, flight deck. We have priority landing clearance Munich in two-zero minutes. Requesting immediate medical status update on the passenger in seat 2A. Advise if condition has deteriorated and confirm paramedic ground coordination acknowledged.
expected_readback: Flight deck, cabin. Priority landing Munich in two-zero minutes copied. Passenger 2A medical status: chest pain persists, conscious, oxygen administered, stable vitals. Condition unchanged from initial report. Paramedic ground coordination acknowledged and confirmed.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 (Manual of Radiotelephony) Section 5.2.1, Annex 6 Part I Chapter 6 (Emergency Procedures)
hint_tr: VIP medical emergency'de flight deck'e detaylı readback şart: landing time, seat number, vital signs durumu ve ground coordination onayını tekrarla. 'Stable' veya 'deteriorated' belirt.
hint_en: For VIP medical events, provide comprehensive readback: confirm landing time, seat location, current vitals status, and acknowledge ground coordination. Specify if patient is stable or deteriorating.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, ground operations. Jetbridge in position, door one left armed and cross-checked. Ground staff ready, you are clear to disarm door and commence disembarkation.
expected_readback: Ground operations, cabin crew. Door one left disarmed and cross-checked, commencing disembarkation.
hint_tr: Door 1L disarm işlemini ve disembarkation başlatma onayını readback'te tekrarla. Ground operations'a hitap etmeyi unutma.
hint_en: Confirm door 1L disarmed status and that you are starting passenger disembarkation. Address ground operations in your readback.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew, flight deck. We are approximately fifteen minutes from landing. Please complete final cabin checks, secure all galley equipment, and ensure passengers are seated with seat belts fastened. Cross-check and report when cabin secure.
expected_readback: Flight deck, cabin crew. Wilco, fifteen minutes to landing, completing final checks, securing galley, passengers seated with seat belts fastened, will cross-check and report cabin secure.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 Cabin Crew Safety Training Manual
hint_tr: Flight deck'ten gelen talimatları onayla: süre (fifteen minutes), yapılacaklar (final checks, galley secure, seat belts) ve cross-check ile raporlama taahhüdü gerekli.
hint_en: Acknowledge the flight deck instruction: confirm time remaining, actions to complete (final checks, galley, seat belts), and commitment to cross-check and report cabin status.

atc_utterance: Purser, Captain here. We've received your report of smoke in the aft cabin. Confirm smoke source identified, passengers moved forward, and crew ready with halon extinguisher. We're initiating descent and diverting to nearest suitable. ETA on ground twenty minutes.
expected_readback: Captain, Purser. Confirmed smoke source not yet identified, all passengers relocated to forward cabin, crew standing by with halon extinguisher ready. Understood descent and diversion, ETA twenty minutes on ground.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9481 Emergency Response Guidance for Aircraft Incidents Involving Dangerous Goods
hint_tr: Captain'ın tüm talimatlarını acknowledge et: smoke source durumu, passenger relocation, halon extinguisher hazırlığı ve descent/diversion bilgilerini readback'te tekrarla.
hint_en: Acknowledge all elements from the Captain: smoke source status, passenger relocation confirmation, halon extinguisher readiness, and descent/diversion details with ETA.

atc_utterance: Purser, this is the Captain. We have confirmed engine fire and hydraulic failure. Prepare cabin for immediate evacuation on my command. Evacuate left side only, slides two left and three left. Right side unsafe due to fire. Stand by for evacuation command.
expected_readback: Understood Captain, preparing for immediate evacuation, left side only, slides two left and three left, right side unsafe, standing by for your command.
key_phrases: slides two left and three left
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9481 Emergency Response Guidance for Aircraft Incidents
hint_tr: Captain'ın evacuation emrinde belirttiği tüm kritik bilgileri readback'te tekrarla: hangi taraf (left side only), hangi slide'lar (2L, 3L), güvenli olmayan taraf (right side unsafe) ve bekleme durumu (standing by).
hint_en: Repeat all critical elements from the Captain's evacuation briefing: which side to evacuate, which specific slides, unsafe areas, and confirm you are standing by for the final command.

atc_utterance: Cabin crew in economy, we have an update on wheelchair assistance. Passenger in seat 24C will need aisle chair for deplaning. Medical assistance not required, passenger is ambulatory but cannot manage cabin aisle. Please coordinate with ground services upon arrival.
expected_readback: Understood, passenger 24C requires aisle chair for deplaning, ambulatory, no medical assistance needed, will coordinate with ground services.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9811 (Human Factors Guidelines), IATA AHM 810
hint_tr: Passenger bilgilerini doğru tekrarla: seat numarası, aisle chair ihtiyacı, ambulatory durumu ve ground services koordinasyonunu onayla.
hint_en: Confirm all passenger details: seat number, aisle chair requirement, ambulatory status, and ground services coordination.

atc_utterance: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Istanbul. The captain has switched off the fasten seatbelt sign. Please remain seated until the aircraft comes to a complete stop. When disembarking, please check your seats for personal belongings. Thank you for flying with us today.
expected_readback: Welcome to Istanbul, seatbelt sign is off, remain seated until complete stop, check for personal belongings, thank you for flying with us.
hint_tr: Disembark announcement'ta seatbelt sign durumu, remain seated talimatı ve personal belongings hatırlatması gerekir.
hint_en: Disembarkation announcement must include seatbelt sign status, remain seated instruction, and reminder to check for personal belongings.

atc_utterance: Line Maintenance, this is Tech 2, pre-departure walk-around complete on Airbus 320 TC-JKM at stand 42. We've observed fluid drops under the left main gear, appears to be hydraulic fluid, approximately 200 milliliters pooled. Aircraft is not serviceable for departure, request engineering inspection.
expected_readback: Roger Tech 2, copy Airbus 320 TC-JKM stand 42, hydraulic fluid leak left main gear, aircraft unserviceable, engineering required. Line Maintenance will dispatch engineer immediately.
hint_tr: Defect report'ta aircraft registration, exact location (left main gear), fluid type (hydraulic), ve unserviceable status mutlaka acknowledge edilmeli.
hint_en: Acknowledge aircraft registration, exact defect location (left main gear), fluid type (hydraulic), and clearly confirm unserviceable status.

atc_utterance: Line Maintenance, Maintenance Control. We have a crew report on Speedbird 2847, Airbus 320, green hydraulic system showing intermittent pressure drop to 1800 PSI during taxi. Aircraft is now at stand Charlie 14. Request you investigate and advise if serviceable for departure scheduled in 90 minutes.
expected_readback: Maintenance Control, Line Maintenance copies. Speedbird 2847, Airbus 320, stand Charlie 14, green hydraulic system intermittent pressure drop to 1800 PSI during taxi. We will investigate and advise serviceability for departure.
hint_tr: Crew report'taki hydraulic system detaylarını ve pressure değerini tekrar et. Stand location ve serviceability check commitment gerekli.
hint_en: Repeat the hydraulic system details and pressure value from crew report. Confirm stand location and commitment to investigate serviceability.

atc_utterance: Line maintenance, this is captain on Alpha Three Seven Bravo. APU failed to start post-flight, EGT remained below minimum, no light-off detected. Can you dispatch a technician to gate Charlie Five for troubleshooting?
expected_readback: Alpha Three Seven Bravo, line maintenance copies APU no start, EGT below minimum, no light-off. Technician dispatching to gate Charlie Five for troubleshooting.
hint_tr: APU arıza bilgisini ve gate location'ı readback'e dahil et. Callsign her zaman ilk sırada.
hint_en: Confirm the APU fault symptoms (EGT, no light-off) and gate location. Always start readback with callsign.

atc_utterance: Line maintenance, this is MOC. We have TC-JBR with MEL item two-nine-zero-one category Bravo, left hydraulic system quantity indication inoperative. Confirm aircraft is serviceable for dispatch with noted restrictions and verify placard installed per MEL procedure.
expected_readback: MOC, line maintenance copies. TC-JBR MEL two-nine-zero-one category Bravo, left hydraulic quantity indication inoperative. Aircraft serviceable for dispatch with MEL restrictions, placard installed and verified.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 (LOSA), MEL procedures per national authority regulations
hint_tr: MEL item numarasını, category'yi ve placard kurulumunu teyit ederken aircraft registration'ı mutlaka tekrarla.
hint_en: Repeat the aircraft registration, MEL item number with category, and confirm both serviceability and placard installation.

atc_utterance: Line Seven, Maintenance Control. Confirm snag entry four-two-three on tech log page one-five is closed. Hydraulic system B low pressure has been rectified, leak isolated on left-hand main landing gear retraction actuator. Action taken: replaced O-ring seal part number seven-three-eight-niner-four-one, system serviced and tested satisfactory.
expected_readback: Line Seven copies. Snag four-two-three closed, hydraulic B low pressure rectified, leak isolated left-hand main gear actuator, O-ring replaced part number seven-three-eight-niner-four-one, system serviced and tested satisfactory.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 (Manual of Radiotelephony) - Non-radio maintenance communication standards
hint_tr: Tech log snag closure'da mutlaka snag numarasını, yapılan action'ı ve part number'ı tekrar et. 'Rectified' veya 'closed' kullan.
hint_en: For tech log snag closure, always repeat the snag number, the action taken, and the part number. Confirm with 'rectified' or 'closed'.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to Line Station, we need to schedule A-check for Tango Charlie Alpha Bravo Hotel. Aircraft has accumulated six hundred flight hours since last check. Can you confirm hangar bay availability for tomorrow zero eight hundred local?
expected_readback: Line Station copies, A-check required for Tango Charlie Alpha Bravo Hotel, six hundred hours accumulated. Hangar bay availability for tomorrow zero eight hundred local, will confirm.
hint_tr: A-check schedule sorusunda aircraft registration, flight hours ve hangar availability zamanını tekrarla.
hint_en: Confirm the aircraft registration, accumulated hours, and requested hangar time slot in your readback.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control, this is Line Bay Three. We've completed the A-check walkaround on Tango Charlie Alpha Seven Two Five. We found a minor hydraulic leak on the number one system near the aft servicing panel, approximately two drops per minute, and a worn brake wear indicator on the right main gear showing amber. All other inspection items are within limits. Requesting guidance on deferral eligibility.
expected_readback: Line Bay Three, Maintenance Control copies A-check complete on Tango Charlie Alpha Seven Two Five, minor hydraulic leak number one system aft servicing panel two drops per minute, right main gear brake wear indicator amber, all other items within limits, requesting deferral guidance.
key_phrases: Tango Charlie Alpha Seven Two Five
hint_tr: A-check bulgularını raporlarken aircraft registration, leak location, leak rate ve deferral request'i açıkça readback et.
hint_en: When acknowledging A-check findings, clearly repeat the aircraft registration, leak location, leak rate, and deferral request.

atc_utterance: Tech Alpha, main gear tire number two showing wear indicators exposed on two grooves, tread depth measuring four millimeters. Check serviceability limits and advise if replacement required before next departure.
expected_readback: Main gear tire two, wear indicators exposed two grooves, tread depth four millimeters, checking serviceability limits and will advise replacement requirement, Tech Alpha.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 Part III Section 2.2.3, ICAO Annex 8 Part II
hint_tr: Tire numarasını, wear indicator durumunu ve tread depth ölçümünü tekrarla. Serviceability limits kontrolünü onaylaman gerekiyor.
hint_en: Repeat tire number, wear indicator status, and tread depth measurement. Confirm you will check serviceability limits and report back.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to Tech 3, brake assembly inspection on Airbus 320 registration TC-JRB complete, findings indicate wear indicators on all four main gear assemblies at amber range, torque stripe intact on all wheel nuts, no hydraulic leaks observed, recommend brake pad replacement within next fifty flight hours, upload report to AMOS and confirm.
expected_readback: Tech 3 copies, brake inspection TC-JRB complete, wear indicators amber range all four main gear assemblies, torque stripe intact, no hydraulic leaks, recommend brake pad replacement within fifty flight hours, uploading report to AMOS, confirmed.
hint_tr: Brake assembly inspection bulgularını tekrarlarken registration numarası TC-JRB, wear indicator durumu (amber range), hydraulic leak durumu (negative) ve önerilen brake pad replacement süresini (fifty flight hours) mutlaka belirtmelisiniz.
hint_en: When reading back brake assembly inspection findings, you must confirm the aircraft registration TC-JRB, wear indicator status at amber range, absence of hydraulic leaks, and the recommended timeframe for brake pad replacement within fifty flight hours.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to A-Check Bay Three, we need a cabin pressure leak test performed on Airbus 320 registration TC-JRB. Pressurize to four point five PSI differential and hold for twenty minutes, then report leak rate and any anomalies found during the test.
expected_readback: A-Check Bay Three copies, cabin pressure leak test on Airbus 320 registration TC-JRB, pressurize to four point five PSI differential, hold twenty minutes, report leak rate and anomalies.
hint_tr: Registration number, pressure değeri (PSI differential) ve test süresi (twenty minutes) mutlaka readback edilmeli. Leak rate raporlama talimatını da onaylayın.
hint_en: Confirm the aircraft registration, exact pressure value in PSI differential, test duration in minutes, and the requirement to report leak rate findings.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control, this is Hangar Bay Three. We have discovered a structural crack on fuselage station 640 during C-check panel removal, measuring approximately eight centimeters in length, propagating from lower stringer attachment. Recommend immediate engineering assessment before proceeding with further inspection tasks.
expected_readback: Hangar Bay Three, Maintenance Control copies structural crack at fuselage station 640, eight centimeters length, lower stringer attachment area. Engineering assessment required, holding further inspection tasks.
hint_tr: Yapısal hasar raporlarında crack location (fuselage station numarası) ve boyutu mutlaka tekrarlanmalı, ardından engineering assessment gerektiği belirtilmeli.
hint_en: Structural damage reports must include exact location with fuselage station number, crack dimensions, and confirmation that engineering assessment is required before continuing work.

atc_utterance: Maintenance team, we have a structural crack indication on fuselage station 727, frame 48, upper left quadrant during NDT scan. Crack length approximately 45 millimeters propagating aft toward stringer 12. Requesting immediate structural engineering assessment and AOG hold on aircraft release pending SRM compliance verification.
expected_readback: Copy structural crack fuselage station 727 frame 48 upper left quadrant, crack length 45 millimeters propagating aft toward stringer 12, requesting structural engineering assessment, AOG hold pending SRM compliance, maintenance team.
hint_tr: Crack lokasyonunu tam olarak tekrarla: fuselage station, frame numarası ve quadrant. SRM compliance ve AOG hold kritik terimlerdir.
hint_en: Repeat exact crack location with fuselage station, frame number, and quadrant. Include crack propagation direction and both assessment requests.

atc_utterance: Maintenance, Quality Control. The FMS upgrade on aircraft Tango Charlie Alpha three five has been inspected. Software version seven point two verified, all system tests satisfactory. You are authorized to sign off the avionics release and update the aircraft technical log with EASA Form One reference.
expected_readback: Quality Control, Maintenance. FMS upgrade Tango Charlie Alpha three five inspected, software version seven point two verified, all system tests satisfactory. Authorized to sign off avionics release and update technical log with EASA Form One reference.
icao_ref: ICAO Annex 6 Part I Ch.8, EASA Part-145
hint_tr: Avionics upgrade onayında software version, aircraft registration ve EASA Form One reference mutlaka readback edilmeli.
hint_en: When confirming avionics certification, read back the software version, aircraft registration, and Form One reference for traceability.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to C-Check Team Leader, reference aircraft Tango Charlie Alpha Bravo Zulu, following completion of fourteen-day C-check with structural inspection panels 4-7-2 through 4-7-8, APU firewall repair under SRM 49-11-02, and replacement of elevator feel computer per TSM 27-21-35, advise aircraft status for return to service certification. Confirm all deferred items transferred to next maintenance interval and all mandatory service bulletins complied with.
expected_readback: Maintenance Control, C-Check Team Leader, Tango Charlie Alpha Bravo Zulu, C-check complete, structural panels 4-7-2 through 4-7-8 closed out, APU firewall repair per SRM 49-11-02 complete, elevator feel computer replaced per TSM 27-21-35, all deferred items transferred, all mandatory service bulletins complied with, aircraft cleared for return to service.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9640 Human Factors Training Manual, EASA Part-145 Maintenance Organization Approvals
hint_tr: Return to service kararında tüm yapılan işleri (structural panels, SRM/TSM referanslarıyla), deferred items transfer durumunu ve service bulletin uyumunu teyit etmelisiniz. Registration'ı phonetic alphabet ile okuyun.
hint_en: For return to service certification, confirm all completed tasks with specific panel numbers and manual references (SRM/TSM), deferred item transfers, and service bulletin compliance status. Use phonetic alphabet for registration.

atc_utterance: Technician Johnson, confirm hydraulic pump assembly replacement on left system completed per AMM 29-21-05, functional test satisfactory, and all related paperwork including the 8130-3 tag entered in the aircraft log. Ready for signoff?
expected_readback: Confirm hydraulic pump assembly replacement left system completed per AMM 29-21-05, functional test satisfactory, paperwork and 8130-3 tag entered in aircraft log, ready for signoff, Technician Johnson.
key_phrases: AMM two nine two one zero five
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 Human Factors Guidelines for Maintenance
hint_tr: Tüm teknik detayları ve AMM referansını readback'te tekrarla. Functional test sonucunu ve 8130-3 tag dokümentasyonunu onayla.
hint_en: Repeat all technical details including AMM reference, confirm functional test result and 8130-3 tag documentation in your readback.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control, we have completed borescope inspection on engine number two. Findings indicate moderate erosion on stage two compressor blades, no cracks detected, oxidation observed on combustion liner panels three and five. Request guidance on corrective action and serviceability status.
expected_readback: Maintenance Control, borescope inspection engine two complete, moderate erosion stage two compressor blades, no cracks, oxidation on combustion liner panels three and five, request corrective action guidance and serviceability status.
hint_tr: Borescope inspection bulgularını readback ederken engine numarasını, erosion seviyesini, lokasyonu (stage two compressor blades) ve ek bulguları (oxidation, combustion liner panels) belirtmelisiniz.
hint_en: When reading back borescope findings, confirm the engine number, severity of erosion, specific location (stage two compressor blades), and additional findings including oxidation locations.

atc_utterance: Engine shop, Maintenance Control. We've been monitoring EGT trend on Tango Charlie Alpha seven three niner, engine number two. Progressive increase observed over last six cycles, currently plus forty-two degrees from baseline at climb power, margin now one hundred eight degrees below redline. Aircraft inbound in four-five minutes, requires your assessment for continued operation or engine change evaluation. Borescope inspection also recommended.
expected_readback: Maintenance Control, Engine shop copies. Tango Charlie Alpha seven three niner, engine two, EGT trend plus forty-two degrees from baseline, margin one zero eight degrees, inbound four-five minutes. Will assess for continued operation versus engine change, and conduct borescope inspection.
key_phrases: Tango Charlie Alpha seven three niner
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 Human Factors Guidelines (Maintenance Communication)
hint_tr: EGT trend raporlarında aircraft registration, engine position, sapma değeri (plus/minus degrees) ve margin'i tekrar et. Assessment ve borescope gibi planlanan aksiyonları acknowledge et.
hint_en: For EGT trend escalations, repeat aircraft registration, engine position, deviation value (plus/minus degrees), and margin. Acknowledge planned actions such as assessment and borescope inspection.

atc_utterance: Maintenance, this is Speedbird 247 Heavy on stand A14. We have a tech log entry for number two engine, oil consumption approximately three litres per flight hour over the last four sectors, quantity decreasing but within limits. Request engineering inspection before next departure.
expected_readback: Speedbird 247 Heavy, Maintenance Control copies number two engine oil consumption three litres per hour last four sectors, quantity within limits, will dispatch engineer to stand A14 for inspection prior to departure.
hint_tr: Number two engine ve oil consumption miktarını tekrarla, stand lokasyonunu ve inspection zamanlamasını doğrula.
hint_en: Confirm the specific engine number, oil consumption rate, aircraft location, and timing of the required inspection.

atc_utterance: Maintenance, this is Control. We have an AOG situation on Tango Charlie Juliet Papa Alpha at stand two-seven. Number two engine has sustained catastrophic turbine damage. We need your assessment on whether we can perform an engine change on stand or if we need to tow to hangar. Time critical – replacement engine is inbound on cargo flight arriving zero-three-thirty Zulu. What's your estimated ground time for the engine swap and post-installation runs?
expected_readback: Control, Maintenance copies. AOG Tango Charlie Juliet Papa Alpha stand two-seven, number two engine catastrophic turbine damage. Will assess on-stand engine change feasibility versus hangar tow. Replacement engine inbound zero-three-thirty Zulu. Will provide ground time estimate for engine swap and post-installation runs.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 Human Factors Guidelines for Aircraft Maintenance
hint_tr: AOG durumlarında callsign, stand numarası, engine numarası ve estimated ground time bilgilerini mutlaka readback edin. Maintenance Control kritik zaman bilgisi beklediği için tüm detayları onaylayın.
hint_en: In AOG situations, always read back the aircraft callsign, stand number, affected engine, and acknowledge the timeline pressure. Maintenance Control needs confirmation you understand the criticality and replacement engine arrival time.

atc_utterance: Engine Shop, Maintenance Control. Aircraft Tango Charlie Alpha Two Three requesting engine performance check after number two engine compressor blade replacement. Ground run approved on stand Echo Seven, monitor EGT limits and confirm N1, N2 values within normal range at seventy percent thrust.
expected_readback: Maintenance Control, Engine Shop copies. Tango Charlie Alpha Two Three, performance check number two engine after compressor blade replacement, ground run stand Echo Seven, monitor EGT limits, confirm N1 N2 normal range at seventy percent thrust.
key_phrases: aircraft Tango Charlie Alpha Two Three
hint_tr: Ground run onayını, aircraft callsign'ı, hangi engine (number two), stand konumunu (Echo Seven), hangi parametreleri (EGT, N1, N2) kontrol edeceğinizi ve thrust seviyesini (70 percent) readback edin.
hint_en: Read back the aircraft callsign, which engine (number two), the maintenance action performed, stand location, parameters to monitor (EGT, N1, N2), and the thrust setting for the performance check.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to landing gear team, you are cleared to commence landing gear retraction test on aircraft Tango Charlie Alpha Three Two Five. Confirm all personnel clear of gear bays and doors, and advise when test sequence is complete.
expected_readback: Landing gear team, cleared to commence landing gear retraction test on Tango Charlie Alpha Three Two Five. All personnel clear of gear bays and doors, will advise when test sequence is complete.
key_phrases: Tango Charlie Alpha Three Two Five
advise when test sequence is complete
hint_tr: Retraction test izni readback'inde aircraft registration (Tango Charlie Alpha Three Two Five) ve tüm güvenlik şartlarını (personnel clear) teyit etmelisiniz.
hint_en: Your readback must confirm the aircraft registration, the specific test type (retraction test), and acknowledge the safety requirement that all personnel are clear of the gear bays before commencing.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to Landing Gear Tech, we need a tire pressure check on Airbus 320 registration TC-JRA, main gear assemblies. Report pressure readings for all four main tires and confirm brake wear indicators are within limits.
expected_readback: Landing Gear Tech copies, tire pressure check on Airbus 320 TC-JRA main gear assemblies, will report all four main tire pressures and confirm brake wear indicators within limits.
hint_tr: Registration TC-JRA'yı tekrarla, main gear tire pressure check görevini onayla ve brake wear indicators kontrolünü de dahil et.
hint_en: Acknowledge the specific aircraft registration TC-JRA, confirm the main gear tire pressure inspection task, and include the brake wear indicator check in your readback.

atc_utterance: Maintenance Control to Landing Gear team, aircraft Alpha Bravo Charlie Seven Two Five. You are cleared to commence hydraulic actuator replacement on the left main landing gear. Ensure hydraulic system B is depressurized and locked out tagout procedures are confirmed prior to disconnecting the actuator. Torque load cell calibration is required post-installation per AMM 32-41-05. Report when ready for operational check.
expected_readback: Landing Gear team copies, Alpha Bravo Charlie Seven Two Five. Cleared to commence hydraulic actuator replacement left main landing gear, hydraulic system B depressurized and locked out tagout confirmed before disconnect, torque load cell calibration per AMM 32-41-05 post-installation, will report ready for operational check.
key_phrases: AMM three two four one zero five
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 Human Factors Guidelines for AMEs
hint_tr: Readback'te aircraft registration (Alpha Bravo Charlie Seven Two Five), hangi gear (left main landing gear), hangi sistem (hydraulic system B), safety procedure (locked out tagout), ve AMM referansı mutlaka tekrarlanmalı.
hint_en: Readback must include aircraft registration, specific gear position, hydraulic system designation, LOTO confirmation, AMM reference number, and acknowledgment of post-installation operational check requirement.

atc_utterance: Brake wear inspection completed on Airbus Three-Two-Zero Tango Charlie Alpha Bravo Golf. Main gear brake assembly shows seven millimeters remaining on inboard pads, nine millimeters on outboard. All brake temps within limits. Sign off task card Two-Three-Dash-Four-Five-Seven in AMOS and release aircraft to service.
expected_readback: Brake wear inspection complete, A320 Tango Charlie Alpha Bravo Golf, seven millimeters inboard, nine millimeters outboard, temps normal, signing off task card Two-Three-Dash-Four-Five-Seven, aircraft released to service.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9824 (Human Factors Training Manual), Maintenance Communication Standards
hint_tr: Brake pad ölçümlerini (inboard/outboard) ve task card numarasını tekrarla. 'Released to service' onayını dahil et.
hint_en: Repeat the exact brake pad measurements for inboard and outboard positions, task card number, and confirm release to service status.

atc_utterance: Maintenance, this is Operations. We have a gear collapse incident on Taxiway Echo, aircraft registration TC-JBK, Boeing 737-800. Left main landing gear collapsed during taxi after landing. Aircraft weight on landing was sixty-two thousand kilograms, no fire, no fuel leak observed. Emergency services are on scene. Request immediate dispatch of landing gear team with jacks and structural assessment equipment to Taxiway Echo.
expected_readback: Operations, Maintenance copies. Gear collapse Taxiway Echo, aircraft TC-JBK, Boeing 737-800, left main gear collapsed during taxi, landing weight sixty-two thousand kilos, no fire, no fuel leak. Dispatching landing gear team with jacks and structural assessment equipment to Taxiway Echo.
icao_ref: ICAO Annex 13 (Aircraft Accident Investigation), Doc 9137 Airport Services Manual Part 7
hint_tr: Incident raporunda aircraft registration, failure türü (left main gear collapse), location (Taxiway Echo) ve talep edilen ekipmanı (jacks, structural assessment equipment) tekrarlamalısınız.
hint_en: In an incident report readback, confirm the aircraft registration, nature of failure (left main gear collapse), exact location, and requested equipment (jacks and structural assessment tools).

atc_utterance: Ground crew ready, brakes released, clear to start pushback.
expected_readback: Brakes released, clear to start pushback.
hint_tr: Cockpit'ten gelen 'brakes released' ve 'clear to start pushback' ifadelerini acknowledge edin.
hint_en: Acknowledge 'brakes released' and 'clear to start pushback' from the cockpit.

atc_utterance: Turkish 247, pushback complete, set brakes, contact ground on 121.9.
expected_readback: Pushback complete, brakes set, contact ground 121.9, Turkish 247.
hint_tr: Pushback complete onayı, brake set ve yeni frekansı readback et. Callsign sonda.
hint_en: Confirm pushback complete, brakes set, and acknowledge the new frequency with your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish 476, tug disconnected, you are released, contact ground on 121.9 when ready to taxi.
expected_readback: Tug disconnected, released, contact ground 121.9 when ready, Turkish 476.
hint_tr: Tug disconnected ve released confirmation'ını tekrarla, sonra contact ground frequency'yi readback et, callsign sonda.
hint_en: Read back tug disconnection, release confirmation, and the ground frequency, finishing with your callsign.

atc_utterance: Turkish 347, stop pushback immediately, ground equipment crossing behind your aircraft. Hold position and standby for further instructions.
expected_readback: Stop pushback immediately, hold position, Turkish 347.
hint_tr: Emergency durumda 'stop pushback immediately' ve 'hold position' ifadelerini callsign ile birlikte readback et.
hint_en: In emergency situations, acknowledge the stop command with 'immediately' and confirm your holding action with callsign.

atc_utterance: Bypass pin removed, gear pins removed, all clear for taxi.
expected_readback: Bypass pin removed, gear pins removed, all clear for taxi.
hint_tr: Ground crew'un bypass pin ve gear pin'leri çıkardığını ve taxi için hazır olduğunu onaylayın.
hint_en: Confirm that the ground crew has removed the bypass pin and gear pins and the aircraft is clear for taxi.

atc_utterance: Aircraft on taxiway Charlie, continue straight ahead, follow my signals. I will guide you to stand Alpha 12.
expected_readback: Continue straight, follow your signals to stand Alpha 12.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9157 Aerodrome Design Manual Part 4
hint_tr: Marshaller'ın talimatlarını tekrarla: 'continue straight', 'follow signals' ve stand numarasını belirt.
hint_en: Repeat marshaller instructions: confirm continuing straight, following signals, and the stand number.

atc_utterance: Aircraft stopping now, chocks are going in. Confirm chocks in place and parking brake set.
expected_readback: Chocks in place, parking brake set confirmed.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9157 Aerodrome Design Manual Part 5
hint_tr: Marshaller chocks yerleştirildiğini ve parking brake'in set olduğunu teyit etmelidir.
hint_en: Confirm that chocks are secured and parking brake is applied after the aircraft stops.

atc_utterance: Turn left, slow down. Watch your right wing tip, obstruction at two o'clock, approximately five metres clearance.
expected_readback: Turning left, reducing speed. Right wing tip monitored, obstruction two o'clock, five metres clearance acknowledged.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9157 Airport Services Manual Part 8 (Apron Marshalling)
hint_tr: Marshaller'ın talimatını tekrarlarken turn direction, speed change ve wing clearance bilgilerini doğrulayın. Obstruction position'ı clock format ile belirtin.
hint_en: Confirm the turn direction, speed adjustment, and acknowledge the wing clearance situation with obstacle position in clock format.

atc_utterance: Stop, stop, stop! Negative clearance your left wing. Tug driver, hold position. Advise cockpit obstacle approximately two meters from wingtip.
expected_readback: Stopping all movement. Holding position. Advising cockpit obstacle two meters from left wingtip.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9157 Aerodrome Design Manual Part 5 (Visual Aids)
hint_tr: Marshaller acil durdurma emri veriyor. 'Stop' tekrarını, 'left wing', obstacle mesafesini ve cockpit'e bildirim onayını readback'e dahil et.
hint_en: Marshaller issues urgent stop command. Include the repetition of 'stop', affected wing, obstacle distance, and confirmation of advising cockpit in your readback.

atc_utterance: Crew acknowledges engine shutdown signal for engine number two. Ground equipment clear to approach.
expected_readback: Engine number two shutdown confirmed, ground equipment clear to approach.
icao_ref: ICAO Annex 14 Vol I, Aerodrome Design and Operations
hint_tr: Engine shutdown confirmation için engine numarasını ve clearance durumunu tekrarla.
hint_en: Confirm which engine is shut down and acknowledge clearance for ground equipment.

atc_utterance: Refueler to cockpit, confirm requested fuel quantity is twelve thousand kilograms plus five hundred kilograms for alternate.
expected_readback: Cockpit, affirm twelve thousand kilograms plus five hundred for alternate, total twelve thousand five hundred kilograms.
hint_tr: Fuel quantity'yi tekrarla: ana yakıt miktarı + alternate fuel miktarı + toplam. Kilogram cinsinden onayla.
hint_en: Repeat fuel quantities: main fuel amount plus alternate fuel amount, then confirm total in kilograms.

atc_utterance: Refueling complete, 18,500 kilograms uplifted, aircraft total fuel 42,300 kilograms. All panels closed and ground equipment clear. You're safe to start engines.
expected_readback: Refueling complete, 18,500 kilograms uplifted, total fuel 42,300 kilograms confirmed. Safe to start engines.
hint_tr: Refueling complete sonrası uplift miktarı ve total fuel quantity'yi tekrarla, ardından safe to start engines onayını ver.
hint_en: Acknowledge the refueling completion by confirming the uplift amount, total fuel quantity, and clearance to start engines.

atc_utterance: All stations, all stations, ramp control, emergency fuel spill reported, stand Charlie 14, all refueling operations cease immediately, deadman activated, fire services notified and responding.
expected_readback: Ramp control, refueling operations ceased, deadman activated, stand Charlie 14, fuel spill acknowledged.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9137 Part 1 (Rescue and Fire Fighting)
hint_tr: Emergency broadcast'te tüm kritik bilgileri readback edin: deadman activation, stand number ve fuel spill acknowledgment gerekli.
hint_en: In emergency broadcasts, read back all critical elements: deadman activation, stand number, and acknowledgment of the fuel spill situation.

atc_utterance: Refueling truck two-seven, confirm your position at stand alpha three-five, you are cleared to approach starboard side.
expected_readback: Position stand alpha three-five, cleared to approach starboard side, refueling truck two-seven.
hint_tr: Stand numarası, hangi taraftan (starboard/port) yaklaşacağınızı ve kendi callsign'ınızı readback'e dahil edin.
hint_en: Readback must include the stand number, which side to approach (starboard/port), and your vehicle callsign.

atc_utterance: Refueling Supervisor, Ramp Control. Negative hot refueling authorized, passengers remain onboard. Request all passengers disembark prior to refueling commencement, engines must be shut down.
expected_readback: Negative hot refueling, passengers disembark prior to refueling, engines shut down, Refueling Supervisor.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9157 Airport Services Manual Part 8
hint_tr: Hot refueling reddedildiğinde, yolcuların ineceğini ve engine shutdown prosedürünü readback et.
hint_en: When hot refueling is denied, confirm passenger disembarkation and engine shutdown procedure in your readback.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 537, de-icing complete with Type Two fluid, holdover time 45 minutes from 0823 Zulu, valid for light freezing drizzle conditions.
expected_readback: De-icing complete Type Two fluid, holdover time 45 minutes from 0823 Zulu, light freezing drizzle, Speedbird 537.
hint_tr: Type Two fluid türünü, holdover time süresini, başlangıç zamanını (Zulu) ve callsign'ı readback'e dahil et.
hint_en: Read back the fluid type (Type Two), holdover time duration, start time in Zulu, and your callsign.

atc_utterance: Lufthansa 498, de-icing complete with Type 1 fluid. Stand by for anti-ice application, Type 4 fluid, holdover time will be approximately 80 minutes in current freezing drizzle conditions. Confirm ready for anti-ice.
expected_readback: Ready for anti-ice application, Type 4 fluid, expecting 80 minutes holdover time, Lufthansa 498.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9640 (Airport Services Manual Part 1 - Snow, Ice and Frost Removal)
hint_tr: Anti-ice application onayını, fluid type'ı ve holdover time'ı readback'te tekrarlamalısınız. Callsign sonda.
hint_en: Confirm readiness for anti-ice treatment, repeat the fluid type and holdover time provided, then add your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Cockpit, de-icing complete. Type four fluid applied, commenced zero-seven-four-five, finished zero-seven-five-two. Holdover time three-five minutes valid until zero-eight-two-seven local. Wings, tail, and fuselage inspected, all clear.
expected_readback: De-icing complete, type four fluid, commenced zero-seven-four-five, finished zero-seven-five-two, holdover time three-five minutes valid until zero-eight-two-seven, all surfaces clear, thank you.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9640 (Aircraft De-icing/Anti-icing Manual), ICAO Annex 6 Part I
hint_tr: De-icing tamamlandığında fluid tipi, başlangıç/bitiş zamanları, holdover time ve yüzey durumu readback edilmelidir. Zaman formatı dört haneli aviation standard.
hint_en: When de-icing is complete, read back the fluid type, start/finish times, holdover time validity, and surface condition. Use four-digit time format.

atc_utterance: Lufthansa 491, deicing complete with Type IV fluid, holdover time is 85 minutes under current conditions, freezing fog with light snow, advise ready for pushback.
expected_readback: Deicing complete, holdover time 85 minutes, Type IV fluid, ready for pushback, Lufthansa 491.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9640 (Airport Services Manual Part 2 - De-icing/Anti-icing)
hint_tr: Holdover time ve fluid type bilgilerini mutlaka tekrarla. Callsign her zaman readback sonunda yer alır.
hint_en: Always confirm the holdover time duration and fluid type. Include your callsign at the end of the readback.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 237, de-icing equipment malfunction on your starboard wing, unable to complete procedure. Request you return to stand Alpha 12 for alternative arrangements and maintenance inspection.
expected_readback: Return to stand Alpha 12 for alternative de-icing arrangements and maintenance inspection, Speedbird 237.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 (Manual of Radiotelephony), Annex 10 Vol II
hint_tr: Stand numarasını ve maintenance inspection talebini readback'e dahil et. Callsign her zaman mesajın sonunda.
hint_en: Confirm the stand number and maintenance inspection requirement. Always end your readback with your callsign.

atc_utterance: Station 4, Ramp Control, report baggage loading status for flight TK1856.
expected_readback: Ramp Control, Station 4, baggage loading complete for TK1856, 145 bags loaded, hold secure.
hint_tr: Baggage loading tamamlandığında flight number, bag count ve hold secure durumunu bildirin.
hint_en: Report completion with flight number, total bag count, and confirm hold is secure.

atc_utterance: Baggage crew, we have three pieces of fragile cargo for THY 1956, musical instruments tagged priority. Load last in forward hold, upright position only, secure with soft restraints.
expected_readback: Three pieces fragile cargo for THY 1956, musical instruments priority, load last forward hold, upright position, soft restraints, baggage crew.
hint_tr: Fragile cargo talimatlarında parça sayısı, flight number, hold konumu ve özel yükleme prosedürü readback edilmeli.
hint_en: Readback must include piece count, flight number, hold location, and all special loading instructions for fragile items.

atc_utterance: Ramp, Load Control. Confirm final cargo weight for compartment three is two thousand one hundred kilograms and forward hold is within limits for flight TK-1754.
expected_readback: Load Control, confirmed compartment three two thousand one hundred kilograms, forward hold within limits, TK-1754.
hint_tr: Cargo weight ve compartment numarasını tekrarla, 'within limits' ifadesini doğrula, callsign'ı readback sonuna ekle.
hint_en: Repeat cargo weight and compartment number, confirm 'within limits' status, include callsign at end of readback.

atc_utterance: Baggage crew, Ops. We have report of damaged baggage from flight TK1856, three checked bags showing severe impact damage on carousel two. Need you to isolate the items, photograph for documentation, and coordinate with station manager for passenger notification. Confirm actions.
expected_readback: Ops, baggage crew copies. Isolate three damaged bags from TK1856 carousel two, photograph for documentation, coordinate with station manager for passenger notification.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9284 Technical Instructions, Annex 17 Security
hint_tr: Damaged baggage handling'de flight number, bag sayısı, ve tüm action items readback edilmelidir. Station manager coordination kritik prosedürdür.
hint_en: For damaged baggage reports, read back the flight number, number of items, and all required actions including documentation and coordination steps.

atc_utterance: Ramp, Baggage Operations. We have five connecting bags from Star Alliance flight 1754 for your Lufthansa 592 departing in twenty-five minutes. Gate transfer in progress, estimate delivery to stand Bravo-12 in ten minutes. Confirm aircraft can wait.
expected_readback: Baggage Operations, Ramp. Copy five connecting bags from Star Alliance 1754 for Lufthansa 592, delivery to stand Bravo-12 in ten minutes. Confirmed aircraft can wait, departure slot permits.
hint_tr: Connecting bag sayısını, geldiği flight numarasını, gidecek flight numarasını ve stand location'ı tekrarla. Bekleme confirmation'ı ekle.
hint_en: Repeat the number of connecting bags, incoming flight number, outbound flight number, and stand location. Confirm the waiting capability.

atc_utterance: Turkish 1521, Istanbul Ground, taxi to holding point runway 35L via Alpha.
expected_readback: Taxi to holding point runway 35L via Alpha, Turkish 1521.
hint_tr: Callsign'ı readback sonunda tekrarla. Taxi talimatını, runway ve taxiway bilgisini aynen oku.
hint_en: Repeat your callsign at the end of the readback. Read back the taxi instruction with runway and taxiway exactly as given.

atc_utterance: Turkish 145, contact tower 118.1.
expected_readback: Contact tower 118.1, Turkish 145.
hint_tr: Frekans değişikliğini ve yeni frekansı tekrar edin. Callsign sonda söylenir.
hint_en: Read back the frequency change instruction with the new frequency. End with your callsign.

atc_utterance: THY452, runway 09, cleared for takeoff, wind 090 degrees 8 knots.
expected_readback: Runway 09, cleared for takeoff, THY452.
hint_tr: Takeoff clearance readback'inde runway numarasını, 'cleared for takeoff' ifadesini tekrarla, sonunda callsign ekle.
hint_en: Repeat the runway number, the phrase 'cleared for takeoff', and add your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 342, climb flight level one zero zero.
expected_readback: Climb flight level one zero zero, Speedbird 342.
hint_tr: Climb instruction'ı readback ederken flight level ve callsign'ı tekrarlamalısınız.
hint_en: When reading back a climb instruction, repeat the flight level and your callsign.

atc_utterance: Turkish 352, turn left heading 270.
expected_readback: Turn left heading 270, Turkish 352.
hint_tr: Turn left heading 270 komutunu tekrarla, sonunda callsign'ını ekle.
hint_en: Repeat the heading instruction and add your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish 742, reduce speed two five zero knots.
expected_readback: Reducing speed two five zero knots, Turkish 742.
hint_tr: Speed talimatını ve knots birimini tekrarla, sonuna callsign ekle.
hint_en: Repeat the speed instruction with unit (knots) and add your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish 351, descend to altitude four thousand feet, QNH one zero one three.
expected_readback: Descend to altitude four thousand feet, QNH one zero one three, Turkish 351.
hint_tr: Descend emrini, altitude değerini ve QNH'yı tekrarla. Callsign sonda.
hint_en: Readback the descend instruction, altitude, and QNH. Include your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish Airlines 1854, turn left heading 270, descend altitude 4000 feet.
expected_readback: Turn left heading 270, descend altitude 4000 feet, Turkish Airlines 1854.
hint_tr: Heading ve altitude talimatlarını tekrar et, sonunda callsign söyle.
hint_en: Read back the heading and altitude instructions, then state your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: THY456, runway 35, cleared to land, wind 340 degrees 8 knots.
expected_readback: Runway 35, cleared to land, THY456.
hint_tr: Cleared to land mesajında runway numarası ve callsign readback edilmelidir. Wind bilgisi readback'e dahil edilmez.
hint_en: Readback must include runway number, clearance, and your callsign. Wind information is not read back.

atc_utterance: Turkish 351, runway vacated, taxi via Alpha to apron 3.
expected_readback: Via Alpha to apron 3, Turkish 351.
hint_tr: Taxiway ismini ve apron numarasını tekrarla. Callsign sonda.
hint_en: Repeat the taxiway name and apron number. Add callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Alpha Bravo Charlie, taxi via taxiway Echo, hold short runway Two Seven.
expected_readback: Taxi via taxiway Echo, hold short runway Two Seven, Alpha Bravo Charlie.
hint_tr: Taxiway ve runway numaralarını NATO phonetic alphabet ile tekrarla. Callsign sonda.
hint_en: Repeat the taxiway and runway numbers using NATO phonetic alphabet. Add callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish 5, taxi to holding point runway 6 via taxiway B.
expected_readback: Taxi to holding point runway 6 via taxiway B, Turkish 5.
hint_tr: Runway ve taxiway numaralarını tek tek oku (6 = six, B = bravo). Callsign sonda tekrarla.
hint_en: Read runway and taxiway numbers individually (6 = six, B = bravo). Repeat callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish 352, squawk 2451.
expected_readback: Squawk 2451, Turkish 352.
hint_tr: Squawk code'u rakam rakam tekrarla: two four five one. Callsign sonda.
hint_en: Read back the squawk code digit by digit, then add your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Turkish Airlines 123, contact Ankara Control on 132.45.
expected_readback: Contact Ankara Control 132.45, Turkish Airlines 123.
key_phrases: one three two decimal four five
hint_tr: Frequency değişikliğinde yeni frekansı ve callsign'ı tekrar edin. 'Contact' kelimesini readback'te kullanın.
hint_en: Readback the new frequency and your callsign. Use 'contact' in your response.

atc_utterance: Good afternoon, I have taxi instructions for you, are you ready to copy?
expected_readback: Ready to copy, Turkish 1865.
hint_tr: Ground sana hitap etmedi ama sen hazırsan, callsign'ını ekleyerek 'ready to copy' de.
hint_en: Ground did not address you directly, so add your callsign when confirming readiness to copy.

atc_utterance: Turkish Airlines 754, Ankara Control, report your estimate for waypoint KABED.
expected_readback: Request estimate for KABED, Turkish Airlines 754.
hint_tr: Controller estimate soruyor. 'Estimate for KABED' derken waypoint ismini tekrarla ve callsign ekle.
hint_en: Controller asks for estimate. Acknowledge the waypoint name and include your callsign in the readback.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 342, taxi via Alpha, hold short of runway 23.
expected_readback: Taxi via Alpha, hold short runway 23, Speedbird 342.
hint_tr: Hold short emrini taksi talimatıyla birlikte readback yapın. Runway numarasını ve callsign'ı tekrarlayın.
hint_en: Read back the taxi instruction with hold short command. Include runway number and your callsign.

atc_utterance: Turkish 352, QNH 1013, report level.
expected_readback: QNH 1013, wilco, Turkish 352.
hint_tr: QNH değerini ve callsign'ı readback et. 'Wilco' kelimesi talimatı kabul ettiğini gösterir.
hint_en: Read back the QNH value and your callsign. Use 'wilco' to acknowledge the instruction to report level.

atc_utterance: Turkish Airlines 452, wind 240 degrees 15 knots, runway 03 right, cleared for takeoff.
expected_readback: Wind 240 degrees 15 knots, runway 03 right, cleared for takeoff, Turkish Airlines 452.
hint_tr: Wind bilgisini derece ve knot olarak, runway numarasını ve takeoff clearance'ı tekrar edin, sonunda callsign ekleyin.
hint_en: Readback the wind direction and speed, runway number, takeoff clearance, and add your callsign at the end.

atc_utterance: Station calling MAYDAY, this is Ankara Control, pass your message.
expected_readback: Ankara Control, MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Speedbird 345, engine fire, maintaining flight level 280, 45 miles south of Ankara, request immediate descent and vectors to nearest suitable airport.
hint_tr: MAYDAY üç kez tekrarla, callsign ver, acil durumu belirt (engine fire), mevcut FL söyle ve nearest airport için descent iste.
hint_en: Say MAYDAY three times, state your callsign, describe the emergency (engine fire), report current flight level, and request immediate descent to nearest airport.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 237, operations. Current METAR for destination Heathrow: wind 250 degrees 18 knots, visibility 8 kilometers in light rain, few at 1200 feet, broken at 2500 feet, temperature 11, dew point 9, QNH 1012. Advise if you require alternate weather.
expected_readback: Operations, Speedbird 237. Copy METAR Heathrow: wind 250 degrees 18 knots, visibility 8 kilometers light rain, few 1200, broken 2500, temperature 11, dew point 9, QNH 1012. Negative on alternate weather at this time.
hint_tr: METAR bilgilerini sırayla tekrarla: wind, visibility, weather, clouds, temperature, QNH. Alternate weather ihtiyacını belirt.
hint_en: Read back METAR elements in order: wind, visibility, weather, clouds, temperature, QNH. State whether you need alternate weather.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 237, ops control. Latest TAF for Madrid shows TEMPO periods of scattered cumulonimbus with moderate turbulence and visibility dropping to three thousand metres in thunderstorms between 1400 and 1800 Zulu. Wind gusting to thirty-five knots from two seven zero. Expected arrival runway two niner left. Advise if you require additional fuel for holding or alternate.
expected_readback: Speedbird 237, roger. TAF Madrid TEMPO scattered cumulonimbus, moderate turbulence, visibility three thousand in thunderstorms 1400 to 1800 Zulu, wind gusting three five knots from two seven zero, runway two niner left. We have sufficient fuel, no additional required.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9432 (Manual of Radiotelephony), Annex 3 (Meteorological Service)
hint_tr: TAF briefing'inde callsign, önemli weather fenomenleri (cumulonimbus, turbulence), visibility, zaman aralığı, wind gust değeri, runway ve fuel durumu readback edilmeli.
hint_en: Read back callsign, significant weather phenomena (CB, turbulence), visibility, time period, wind gusts, runway, and fuel decision clearly to ops control.

atc_utterance: All stations, Ankara Control, SIGMET advisory valid from 1015 to 1415 UTC, moderate turbulence observed flight level 310 to 370 within 50 nautical miles of BUDAP intersection due to mountain wave activity, pilots report occasional severe intensity, request amended flight plan if required.
expected_readback: Ankara Control, copied SIGMET advisory, moderate turbulence flight level 310 to 370 vicinity BUDAP, valid 1015 to 1415 UTC, [callsign].
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.12.3, Annex 3 Ch.9 SIGMET
hint_tr: SIGMET bilgisinin readback'inde turbulence şiddeti, flight level aralığı, lokasyon (BUDAP intersection) ve geçerlilik saatleri mutlaka tekrarlanmalı.
hint_en: SIGMET readback must include turbulence intensity, flight level range, location reference, and validity period.

atc_utterance: Flight Operations, be advised NOTAM A0234 effective from 1200 to 1800 UTC today, runway 16 right closed for maintenance. All departures and arrivals will use runway 16 left. Confirm you have copied this information.
expected_readback: Copied, NOTAM Alpha zero two three four, runway one six right closed one two zero zero to one eight zero zero UTC, all operations runway one six left.
key_phrases: NOTAM Alpha zero two three four
one two zero zero to one eight zero zero
hint_tr: NOTAM numarasını, kapalı runway'i, zaman aralığını ve alternatif runway'i readback'e dahil et.
hint_en: Include the NOTAM number, closed runway, time window, and alternative runway in your readback.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, OPS Control, be advised NOTAM effective 1200 to 1800 zulu today, ILS runway two seven at LTBA is out of service for maintenance, category one approaches only, advise all inbound flights to plan RNAV or VOR approach.
expected_readback: OPS Control, Dispatch copies, NOTAM effective 1200 to 1800 zulu, ILS runway two seven LTBA out of service, CAT one only, will advise inbound flights RNAV or VOR approach.
key_phrases: twelve hundred to eighteen hundred zulu
hint_tr: NOTAM bilgisinde ILS runway numarası, zaman aralığı (zulu), category kısıtlaması ve alternatif approach türlerini readback'e dahil et.
hint_en: Readback must include the ILS runway number, effective time window in zulu, category restriction, and alternative approach types from the NOTAM.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, this is Speedbird 217 heavy. We're two hours from entry point. Request current weather at ETOPS alternates Keflavik and Narsarsuaq, and confirm adequate status remains for both.
expected_readback: Speedbird 217 heavy, Dispatch copies. Will provide current weather for Keflavik and Narsarsuaq ETOPS alternates and confirm adequate status for both.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.16, Annex 6 Part I
hint_tr: ETOPS flight sırasında crew, dispatcher'dan alternate havaalanlarının adequate status'ünü teyit eder. Readback'te callsign, her iki alternate ismi ve 'adequate status' vurgulanmalı.
hint_en: During ETOPS operations, crew requests dispatcher confirmation that both alternates remain adequate. Readback must include callsign, both alternate names, and confirmation of adequate status check.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 217, this is London Dispatch. Due to weather deterioration at Keflavik, we are amending your ETOPS alternate to Narsarsuaq. New critical point is 58 North 030 West. Please confirm reception and advise fuel state for new alternate assessment.
expected_readback: London Dispatch, Speedbird 217. Copy ETOPS alternate change to Narsarsuaq, new critical point 58 North 030 West. Current fuel on board 42.8 tonnes, estimating critical point in 47 minutes.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.12, Annex 6 Part I ETOPS
hint_tr: ETOPS alternate değişikliğinde yeni alternate havaalanı adını, critical point koordinatlarını ve fuel state bilgisini readback et. Dispatcher sana fuel assessment için FOB soruyor.
hint_en: Acknowledge the new ETOPS alternate airport, read back the revised critical point coordinates, and provide current fuel on board for dispatcher's alternate assessment.

atc_utterance: Turkish 247, Ankara Control, flight plan filed and processed, route OPELA UN984 ROKAN UL603 RIVGO, flight level 370, estimating OPELA at time 14, squawk 5324.
expected_readback: Ankara Control, Turkish 247, flight plan received, route OPELA UN984 ROKAN UL603 RIVGO, flight level 370, OPELA time 14, squawk 5324.
key_phrases: route OPELA UN984 ROKAN UL603 RIVGO
hint_tr: Flight plan confirmation readback'inde route ve flight level detaylarını eksiksiz tekrar edin, squawk code'u da dahil edin.
hint_en: When reading back flight plan confirmation, repeat the full route, flight level, and squawk code to confirm receipt of all filed details.

atc_utterance: THY452, ops. Due severe weather at PIGOR, we're planning route revision via KONAN then direct OMOLU. New flight plan estimate adds 18 minutes, fuel overhead remains 4500 kilos. Advise when ready to copy revised route.
expected_readback: THY452, ready to copy. Route revision via KONAN direct OMOLU, 18 minutes additional, fuel overhead 4500 kilos, THY452.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.11 (Flight Plan), Doc 9432 (Manual of Radiotelephony)
hint_tr: Route revision için waypoint isimlerini (KONAN, OMOLU) doğru readback edin, fuel overhead ve zaman farkını onaylayın, callsign ekleyin.
hint_en: Confirm the revised waypoints (KONAN, OMOLU), acknowledge the time addition and fuel overhead, include your callsign in readback.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, Speedbird 287, we have a medical emergency on board, passenger unconscious, requesting immediate divert options. Current position 150 miles northwest of Vienna, fuel remaining 8.2 tonnes, endurance approximately 90 minutes, moderate turbulence reported on current track. Require nearest suitable airport with medical facilities.
expected_readback: Speedbird 287, Dispatch copies medical emergency, passenger unconscious, position 150 miles northwest of Vienna, fuel 8.2 tonnes, endurance 90 minutes, standby for divert options with medical facilities.
hint_tr: Medical emergency durumunda dispatcher tüm kritik bilgileri readback etmeli: pozisyon, fuel, endurance ve passenger durumu. Divert options için standby demeyi unutma.
hint_en: In medical emergency scenarios, dispatcher must read back all critical information: position, fuel state, endurance, and passenger condition before coordinating diversion.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, Speedbird 217, we are coordinating a possible diversion to Munich due to weather at Vienna. Current fuel on board is 8.2 tonnes, estimated fuel at Munich overhead is 6.4 tonnes. Request you arrange additional 4 tonnes uplift at Munich for continuation to Vienna, flight time Munich to Vienna 35 minutes.
expected_readback: Speedbird 217, roger, arranging 4 tonnes uplift at Munich, fuel on board 8.2, estimated 6.4 at Munich, flight time to Vienna 35 minutes, will coordinate with Munich ground services.
hint_tr: Dispatcher olarak fuel uplift miktarını ve destination aerodrome'u readback'te tekrarlamalısınız. Estimated fuel remaining ve coordination commitment gereklidir.
hint_en: As dispatcher, confirm the exact fuel uplift quantity, destination aerodrome, and fuel figures. Acknowledge coordination responsibility with ground services.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, Speedbird 247, requesting block fuel calculation for alternate diversion to EGPF due weather at destination, current position 52 North 010 West, estimating EGPF in 45 minutes, souls on board 189.
expected_readback: Speedbird 247, roger, calculating block fuel for EGPF diversion, current position 52 North 010 West, estimate 45 minutes, 189 souls on board, standby.
key_phrases: one eight nine souls on board
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.11, Doc 9426 Flight Planning
hint_tr: Block fuel hesaplaması için callsign, alternate havalimanı ICAO kodu, tahmini süre ve souls on board bilgisini readback'te tekrarla.
hint_en: Confirm callsign, alternate airport ICAO code, estimated time, and souls on board when acknowledging the block fuel calculation request.

atc_utterance: Turkish 701, company. We've received notification from Istanbul Control that you declared minimum fuel inbound LTBA. Confirm your current fuel state, souls on board, and whether you require priority handling or any additional support from operations.
expected_readback: Turkish 701, affirm minimum fuel declared. Current fuel 2.8 tonnes, 167 souls on board. Negative additional support required at this time, priority handling accepted.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.15, Annex 10 Vol II
hint_tr: Minimum fuel declaration'ı acknowledge edin, fuel state'i tonlarda belirtin, souls on board sayısını verin ve priority handling kabul/ret durumunu belirtin.
hint_en: Acknowledge the minimum fuel declaration, state current fuel in tonnes, confirm souls on board, and clarify whether priority handling is accepted or additional operational support is needed.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 217, this is dispatch, we're monitoring your fuel state. Current holding at ROKIL shows you'll be approaching minimum holding fuel in approximately 18 minutes. Advise if you require diversion planning to alternate.
expected_readback: Dispatch, Speedbird 217, roger, approaching minimum holding fuel in 18 minutes at ROKIL. We'll advise if diversion required.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.15 (Fuel Emergency), Doc 9833 (Fuel Management)
hint_tr: Dispatcher'ın fuel reserve uyarısına callsign ile başla, minimum holding fuel durumunu ve süreyi onayla, gerekirse diversion planlama talebini belirt.
hint_en: Acknowledge the fuel advisory with callsign, confirm the time until minimum holding fuel, and state you will advise if diversion planning is needed.

atc_utterance: Flight operations, Speedbird 237 heavy. We've declared minimum fuel. Current endurance is 42 minutes. LTFM weather is now below our alternate minima with visibility 400 meters in freezing fog. Request immediate alternate recommendations within our fuel range and NOTAM status for LTAC and LTFE.
expected_readback: Speedbird 237 heavy, ops control copies minimum fuel declared, 42 minutes endurance. LTFM below alternate minima, 400 meters visibility freezing fog. Standby for LTAC and LTFE alternate options with NOTAM check.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.15.5, Doc 9376 Emergency Phase
hint_tr: Minimum fuel declaration'da endurance süresini ve talep edilen alternate havalimanlarını (LTAC, LTFE) readback'e dahil et. NOTAM check isteğini mutlaka onayla.
hint_en: Acknowledge the minimum fuel state with exact endurance time, confirm the requested alternates LTAC and LTFE, and verify NOTAM check will be provided.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, this is Flow Control. Speedbird 215, your EDCT for EGLL has been revised to 1445 UTC due slot compression at EGTT. Advise crew and confirm acceptance.
expected_readback: Flow Control, Dispatch copies. Speedbird 215, EDCT revised to 1445 UTC, EGLL, slot compression EGTT. Will advise crew and confirm acceptance.
hint_tr: EDCT (Expect Departure Clearance Time) değişikliğini callsign, yeni saat ve havaalanı ile tekrarla. Crew'e bildirim onayını ekle.
hint_en: Readback the revised EDCT with callsign, new time, and airport. Confirm you will notify the crew.

atc_utterance: Turkish 751, this is EUROCONTROL IFPS. Your CTOT has been revised to 1345 UTC due to ATFCM slot reallocation. New EOBT 1315 UTC. Please confirm acceptance and update your flight plan accordingly.
expected_readback: EUROCONTROL IFPS, Turkish 751. Revised CTOT 1345 UTC, new EOBT 1315 UTC due to ATFCM slot reallocation confirmed. We will update the flight plan.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.16 ATFM, EUROCONTROL IFPS procedures
hint_tr: CTOT ve EOBT saatlerini UTC formatında tekrar edin. Callsign'ınızı ve ATFCM slot bilgisini onaylayın.
