hint_en: Read back the revised CTOT and EOBT in UTC format. Confirm your callsign and acknowledge the ATFCM slot reason.

atc_utterance: Operations, this is dispatch. Confirm diplomatic clearance status for THY815 routing Istanbul-Damascus. Syrian overflight permit expiry showing 15th current month, need verification before flight planning.
expected_readback: Dispatch, operations copies. Will verify Syrian diplomatic clearance for THY815, overflight permit expiry date 15th current month, confirm before flight plan finalization.
hint_tr: Dispatcher diplomatic clearance sorgulamasına flight numarası, permit expiry date ve verification gereksinimini readback'te tekrarla.
hint_en: Acknowledge the flight number, permit expiry date, and confirmation that verification is needed before flight planning.

atc_utterance: Turkish 751, Flight Ops. Request crew duty time status for Captain and First Officer. Also confirm remaining flight duty period available if diversion to alternate becomes necessary.
expected_readback: Turkish 751, Captain has 9 hours 15 minutes duty time logged, First Officer 8 hours 45 minutes. Flight duty period remaining 4 hours 45 minutes for Captain, 5 hours 15 minutes for First Officer. Sufficient for diversion to alternate.
icao_ref: ICAO Annex 6 Part I Ch.4 (Flight Time, Flight Duty Period)
hint_tr: Her iki pilot için duty time ve kalan flight duty period bilgisini sırayla verin, alternate'e diversion için yeterli olup olmadığını onaylayın.
hint_en: Report duty time for both crew members separately, state remaining flight duty period for each, and confirm adequacy for potential diversion to alternate.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, Maintenance. We have a hydraulic system B low quantity indication on your aircraft, tail number Tango Charlie 3-7-2. Item is MEL category C, 3-day deferral. Blue hydraulic system will be isolated, performance data adjusted for single hydraulic operation. You'll need to brief the crew on alternate extension procedures and increased landing distance.
expected_readback: Maintenance, Dispatch copies. Tail Tango Charlie 3-7-2, hydraulic system B low quantity, MEL category C, 3-day deferral, blue hydraulic isolated, performance adjusted for single hydraulic ops, will brief crew on alternate extension and increased landing distance.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 9835 (MEL procedures), ICAO Doc 10002 (Human Factors)
hint_tr: MEL deferral bilgisini tekrarlarken mutlaka tail number, MEL category, deferral süresi ve operasyonel kısıtlamaları belirtmelisiniz. Crew briefing sorumluluğunu onaylayın.
hint_en: When reading back MEL deferral information, always confirm the tail number, MEL category, deferral period, and operational restrictions. Acknowledge your responsibility to brief the flight crew.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 217, dispatch. We're receiving multiple reports of moderate to severe turbulence in your area, flight levels 330 through 370. Request pilot report on current ride conditions, turbulence intensity, and whether you recommend altitude change for following traffic.
expected_readback: Dispatch, Speedbird 217. Currently flight level 350, experiencing moderate turbulence, occasional severe bumps. Ride is uncomfortable, recommend traffic avoid this level. Light to moderate reported at flight level 310 by preceding aircraft.
hint_tr: PIREP verirken callsign, mevcut flight level, turbulence şiddeti ve diğer traffic için tavsiye belirtilmelidir.
hint_en: When providing a PIREP, include callsign, current flight level, turbulence intensity, and recommendation for following traffic.

atc_utterance: Speedbird 217, operations. We have a revised zero fuel weight for you due to payload correction. New zero fuel weight is 182.3 tonnes, center of gravity 23.5 percent MAC. Confirm you can accept this update and recalculate performance for destination.
expected_readback: Operations, Speedbird 217. Accept zero fuel weight 182.3 tonnes, center of gravity 23.5 percent MAC. Will recalculate performance.
hint_tr: Zero fuel weight ve center of gravity değerlerini tekrar et. MAC yüzde olarak okunur. Recalculate performance diyerek onay ver.
hint_en: Repeat the zero fuel weight and center of gravity values. Confirm you will recalculate performance with the new data.

atc_utterance: DAL542, Operations. Due to reported braking action medium at destination, confirm your current fuel on board and verify landing weight will remain within performance limits for runway two seven with fifteen knot tailwind component.
expected_readback: Operations, DAL542. Current fuel on board one-five thousand kilograms, landing weight six-two tons, confirms within performance limits runway two seven, fifteen knot tailwind.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 8168 PANS-OPS Vol I, Doc 9365 All Weather Operations
hint_tr: Dispatcher olarak fuel on board miktarını, landing weight'i ve runway performance limitlerini Operations'a confirm etmelisin. Tailwind component bilgisini acknowledge et.
hint_en: As dispatcher, confirm fuel quantity in kilograms, landing weight in tons, and verify it meets runway performance limits with the tailwind component acknowledged.

atc_utterance: Turkish 347, Ankara Control advises significant volcanic ash SIGMET Charlie active between FL200 and FL350 covering your planned route sectors UTAA and LTBB. Request immediate flight plan revision via ERAKA-TEGMO alternate routing and descent to FL190 prior to BASPU, or diversion to Antalya as alternate. Current ash cloud movement northeast at 25 knots, expected to affect your route for next 4 hours minimum.
expected_readback: Turkish 347 copies volcanic ash SIGMET Charlie FL200 to FL350 affecting UTAA and LTBB sectors, revising flight plan via ERAKA-TEGMO alternate route with descent to FL190 before BASPU, Antalya available as alternate, ash moving northeast 25 knots, 4 hour minimum duration.
icao_ref: ICAO Doc 4444 Ch.15.4, Doc 9766 Volcanic Ash Contingency Plan
hint_tr: SIGMET numarasını, etkilenen FL aralığını, alternate route waypoint'lerini ve descent seviyesini eksiksiz readback edin. Volcanic ash advisory'de alternate havalimanı mutlaka teyit edilir.
hint_en: Read back the SIGMET identifier, affected flight level range, alternate route waypoints, and descent level completely. Always confirm alternate airport in volcanic ash scenarios.

atc_utterance: Dispatch, Shanwick Radio relayed Speedbird 215 position report: 50 North 30 West at time 1342, flight level 380, estimating 51 North 40 West at time 1423, next 52 North 50 West. Aircraft reports Mach point 84, fuel remaining 42 point 8 tonnes.
expected_readback: Speedbird 215 position, 50 North 30 West at 1342, flight level 380, estimating 51 North 40 West at 1423, next 52 North 50 West, Mach point 84, 42 point 8 tonnes fuel remaining, received.
hint_tr: HF position report relay'de mutlaka callsign, waypoint koordinatları, time, flight level, next waypoint ve fuel bilgilerini tekrar et.
hint_en: In HF position report relays, always read back callsign, waypoint coordinates, time, flight level, next waypoint estimate, and fuel information.
